svg.title: Motion guidance and appearance refinement pipeline
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction of a two-part pipeline figure. Top frame (a) inventories extraction of first-frame Gaussians, optimized 4D Gaussians, two editing photos with camera icons, anchor construction from source/edited Gaussians, anchor correspondence transport, and motion guidance ellipses. Bottom frame (b) inventories rendered first frames, warped image/optical-flow/loss/color-uncertainty computation, rendered t-th frames, rasterization/sampling process boxes, and edited Gaussian deformation. Symmetry basis: upper row flows left-to-right; lower row has a central horizontal refinement pipeline with right-to-left and vertical feedback arrows. SAM replacements are applied only for confirmed picture crops while native construction remains with stable IDs.
